summary: Durable artifact-claim registry (cinatra#1425, epic #1424 foundation). Adds artifact_type_claims — scope ('platform'|'org:<id>') × object type claims by installed kind:'artifact' extensions, lifecycle reserved→active→retiring→retired plus 'dormant' for a default claim dominated by a dedicated one; constraint-backed arbitration via two partial unique indexes (one ACTIVE claim per scope key; two DEDICATED claimants on the same type at the same scope conflict while live); install_id is plain-text provenance (no FK — claims survive uninstall's installed_extension delete). Adds artifact_claim_events — append-only claim-event history (reserve/activate/retire/winner-change with actor+version+scope), no FKs, BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger raises, so history survives claim retirement and installed-row deletion. Adds artifact_binding_reconcile_queue — durable winner-change work queue (one 'binding-reconcile' + one 're-projection' row per winner change, written in the winner transition's transaction; consumer lands with the binding write-path sub-issue). Additive (brand-new empty tables) — artifact not REQUIRED, shipped to keep fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade aligned (core__0027/core__0030 precedent); mirrors the idempotent bootstrap DDL (buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries → artifactClaimSchemaQueries). down() drops the three tables + trigger/function (derived registration state re-derives from installed manifests).
